claim.claim-text: 1. An aerosol generating system, comprising an aerosol generating device (20) for generating an aerosol and an airflow sensor; wherein the aerosol generating device (20) comprises a first atomizer (21, 21a, 21b) for heating a first aerosol-forming substrate to generate an aerosol, and a second atomizer (22, 22b) for heating a second aerosol-forming substrate to generate an aerosol; the airflow sensor (27) comprises a first sensing surface (271) and a second sensing surface (272);
characterized in that:

2. The aerosol generating system according to claim 1, wherein the aerosol generating device (20) further comprises a fourth airflow channel (Q4); the first sensing surface (271) is communicated with the outside atmosphere through the fourth airflow channel (Q4).
3. The aerosol generating system according to claim 1 or 2, further comprising a power supply device (10) for powering the aerosol generating device (20); wherein
4. The aerosol generating system according to claim 1 or 2, further comprising a power supply device (10) for powering the aerosol generating device (20); wherein

5. The aerosol generating system according to claim 3 or 4, wherein the aerosol generating device (20) further has a third position with respect to the power supply device (10); when the aerosol generating device (20) is in the third position, the aerosol generating device (20) is non-conductively connected to the power supply device (10) in the third position.
6. The aerosol generating system according to any one of claims 1-5, further comprising a controller (29), wherein

the airflow sensor (27) is a pressure-differential airflow sensor or a microphone; the controller (29) is configured to control the power supply device (10) to output power according to a value of an air pressure difference attained by the airflow sensor (27).
7. The aerosol generating system according to claim 6, wherein

the controller (29) is further configured to compare a preset threshold with a value of an air pressure difference between the first air pressure value and the second air pressure value; the controller (29) is further configured to, when the value of an air pressure difference is larger than preset threshold, control the power supply device (10) to output power.
8. The aerosol generating system according to claim 6, wherein

the controller (29) is further configured to adjust the output power according to the value of the air pressure difference; the controller (29) is further configured to adjust the output power to become larger when the value of the air pressure difference becomes larger.
9. The aerosol generating system according to claim 1, further comprising a controller (29), wherein

the first sensing surface (271) is configured to sense a first air pressure value of the outside atmosphere; the second sensing surface (272) is configured to sense a second air pressure value of the airflow in the third airflow channel (Q3); the controller (29) is configured to calculate the value of the air pressure difference between the first air pressure value and the second air pressure value.
10. The aerosol generating system according to any one of claims 1-5, wherein the aerosol generating system further comprises

11. The aerosol generating system according to claim 10, wherein the controller (29) is configured to control the power supply device (10) to output power to the first atomizer (21, 21a, 21b) when the position detecting component (40) detects that the aerosol generating device (20) is in the first position; and/or, control the power supply device (10) to output power to the second atomizer (22, 22b) when the position detecting component (40) detects that the aerosol generating device (20) is in the second position.
12. The aerosol generating system according to claim 11, wherein
13. The aerosol generating system according to claim 12, wherein

the power supply device (10) comprises a first electrode and a second electrode; the first contact (121) is connected to the first electrode, and the detection circuit (43) comprises a first voltage divider resistor (R1) and second voltage divider resistor (R2); wherein the first end of the first voltage divider resistor (R1) is connected to the conductive connector (41), the second end thereof is connected to the first end of the second voltage divider resistor (R2), and the second end of the second voltage divider resistor (R2) is connected to the second electrode; the controller (29) further comprises a voltage sampling terminal for collecting voltage values at both ends of the second voltage divider resistor (R2), the voltage sampling terminal is connected to the first end of the second voltage divider resistor (R2); and the controller (29) controls the power supply device (10) to output power to the first atomizer (21, 21a, 21b) or the second atomizer (22, 22b) according to the collected voltage values.
14. The aerosol generating system according to claim 10, wherein

the position detecting component (40) comprises a magnetic field generator provided on one of the aerosol generating device (20) or the power supply device (10), and a Hall sensor provided on the other thereof; the magnetic field generator is configured to generate a magnetic field; the Hall sensor is configured to sense a change in the intensity of the magnetic field at the position where it is located to generate a sensing signal; and the controller (29) controls the power supply device (10) to output power to the first atomizer (21, 21a, 21b) or the second atomizer (22, 22b) according to the sensing signal of the Hall sensor.
15. The aerosol generating system according to claim 10, wherein

the position detecting component (40) comprises a reflective photoelectric sensor provided on one of the aerosol generating device (20) or the power supply device (10); the reflective photoelectric sensor has a light emitting end and a reflected light receiving end, and generates a sensing signal according to the intensity of the reflected light received by the reflected light receiving end; the controller (29) is configured to control the power supply device (10) to output power to the first atomizer (21, 21a, 21b) or the second atomizer (22, 22b) according to the sensing signal of the reflective photoelectric sensor.
